_comment: Copy this folder to data/shops/<your-slug>/ and fill in the values below. Use lowercase, dashes-only for the slug (e.g. pizza-bob, joes-takeaway). The slug becomes the SHOP_SLUG env var in this shop's Cloudflare Pages project.

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name.
business._comment_todo: REBRAND STAGED ON DEV — Food Station is becoming Big Bites. bigbiteseasingwold.uk is bought (external registrar, 2026-07-30); its nameservers are being pointed at Cloudflare so the zone can be added to this Pages project. Remaining go-live steps IN ORDER — each one depends on the one before, so do not jump ahead: 1) add bigbiteseasingwold.uk + www as a SECOND custom domain on this Pages project (do NOT detach foodstationyork.uk); 2) confirm /api/config serves and a test order completes on the new host; 3) merge dev -> main so the new domain actually serves Big Bites (custom domains serve the PRODUCTION branch, so until this merge the new domain shows the old Food Station site); 4) re-register the wallet domain for the new host via /api/staff/wallet-domain (Apple/Google Pay register per exact hostname, so this does NOT carry over — same trap that left Mega Chippy without wallet buttons); 5) verify the new domain in Resend and switch RESEND_FROM_EMAIL, plus Cloudflare Email Routing for orders@; 6) flip business.domain/email below; 7) repoint the till: app/web/provision.js Restaurant ID 833541 still maps to www.foodstationyork.uk; 8) 301 the old foodstationyork.uk zone to the new domain (keep 6-12 months) — STRICTLY LAST, and never blanket /* (it would break /api and /staff on the live till); 9) rename the Google Business Profile (EDIT, never re-create — re-creating loses the reviews); 10) delete the closures "*" entry to reopen ordering. Phone resolved 2026-07-30 (see _comment_phone). legalName stays FOOD STATION 56 LTD unless the company itself renames at Companies House.
business._comment_phone: Owner confirmed 2026-07-30: 01347 820820 is the correct number (the one printed in the Big Bites brand guidelines). The old Food Station number 01347 824522 was carried over in error. This feeds the landing page call buttons, the JSON-LD telephone, the order confirmation and the Google Business Profile — they must all match.
business._comment_email: MUST be a real, monitored inbox — build-shop.js feeds it into {{contactLine}}, which is the data-controller contact on privacy.html, terms.html and allergy-info.html, i.e. the address a customer uses to demand their data or complain before going to the ICO. Set up Cloudflare Email Routing for orders@bigbiteseasingwold.co.uk -> the shop's real inbox. If that is not in place by go-live, blank this field instead of leaving a bouncing address: build-shop.js:400 only adds the email clause when it is set, so the legal pages fall back to phone-only, which is honest and still compliant.
business._comment_domain: Switched to bigbiteseasingwold.co.uk on 2026-07-30 (bought at GoDaddy, DNS moved to Cloudflare, attached to this Pages project with www). Apex, not www — www 301s here via public/_redirects, matching how Rico's and Mega Chippy are set up. Drives canonical, og:url, JSON-LD url and every sitemap.xml loc, so it must always name the host that actually serves without redirecting. NOTE the brand guidelines p9 print bigbiteseasingwold.uk (no .co) — that domain is NOT owned; the printed guidelines are wrong, not this.

_comment_seo: Search-engine extras used to build the landing page's JSON-LD Restaurant schema + social meta. cuisine + priceRange feed the structured data; addressRegion sharpens the location; sameAs links your social profiles to the business in Google (paste your Facebook / Instagram / TikTok URLs); description overrides the default meta/OG text. None of this changes the page visually — it's purely for search engines.

seo._comment_description: This is the line Google shows under the result, so it is written for a person, not a crawler. It leads with the exact phrase people search — "Big Bites Easingwold" — because that adjacency is what a brand-name query matches on.
seo.description: Big Bites Easingwold — big flavour, big portions. Pizza, parmo, kebab, burgers and loaded wraps. Order online for collection or delivery around Easingwold.
seo._comment_ogImage: The picture shown when the link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or in a text — which for a local takeaway is most of how it travels. Must be a real 1200x630 image; a logo letterboxes into the card and looks like nothing. Built from the brand assets by the script in the session notes; regenerate it if the branding changes. Relative to the site root (it is copied to public/assets/ by the build).
seo._comment_geo: Shop coordinates for the Restaurant schema and the delivery service-area circle. EMPTY ON PURPOSE — do not guess these. Open https://api.postcodes.io/postcodes/YO61%203HT in a browser and paste the "latitude" and "longitude" values in as numbers. The build cannot fetch them itself: it runs on pure Node built-ins with no network, so a deploy must never depend on an external API being up.
seo._comment_sameAs: The shop's own social profiles, emitted as schema.org sameAs. This is how Google ties the website, the socials and the Google Business Profile together as ONE business entity, which is why it matters for local search. Supplied by the owner 2026-07-30; both are the canonical profile URLs, with the QR/referral tracking parameters (igsh=, utm_source=, mibextid=) stripped, and the Facebook /share/ redirect shim replaced by the real page address. NOTE: the Facebook page has no username yet, so its canonical URL is the numeric profile.php?id= form. If the shop later claims a username the page URL changes to facebook.com/<name> — update this array at the same time, and the printed menu with it.

_comment_theme: Food Station palette (Brand Identity Guide vol.01). Tomato Red #D72C26 = primary (headlines, buttons). Mustard #F2B91D = accent. Cream #FBF5E9 = background (never pure white). Brand also uses Leaf Green #4FAE3F (secondary) and Charcoal #1A1A1A (text/outlines) — no theme slot, applied in the custom landing/CSS. Type: Poppins Bold (display) / Poppins Regular (body).

delivery._comment_mode: Radius/distance delivery. The customer postcode is geocoded (postcodes.io, free, no key) and the straight-line distance from the shop selects a band fee. Origin defaults to the shop's own postcode (business.address.postcode); set radius.origin {lat,lng} to override. Matches the old site's £1 + £1/mile rings (1-mile bands, £1-£5, max 5 miles).

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order service charge in pence, shown to the customer at checkout and added to the total. SPLIT: serviceFeePlatformPence is taken as the Stripe Connect application_fee (Lumin Labs' cut); the rest stays with the venue. On card orders the split is automatic; on cash orders the venue collects the whole charge and the platform reconciles its share separately.
_comment_serviceFeePlatform: Of serviceFeePence, the portion taken as the platform application_fee (Lumin Labs). The remainder stays with the shop — here a £1.00 charge = 50p platform + 50p shop.
_comment_stripe: Stripe Connect: this site's PaymentIntents are created on the venue's connected account. connectedAccountId is the venue's acct_xxx string from Stripe Connect.
_comment_pos: Till behaviour. externalCardMachine:true makes the staff till's Card button record the sale as paid by card immediately — Food Station takes the actual payment on its own third-party card machine, so there is no LumiPOS Stripe reader to drive. The website still takes online card payments via Stripe normally. requireOrderPin:false — staff take orders (walk-in/collection/delivery) without entering a per-order code; the manager/owner PIN on voids, refunds and cancellations is separate and still always required.

hours._comment: 24-hour format. Source: printed menu — Sun-Thu 4pm-10pm, Fri-Sat 4pm-11pm.

_comment_closures: One-off emergency closures. Each "YYYY-MM-DD" (shop-local) takes online ordering OFFLINE for that whole day and shows a popup with the message. Self-expires once the date passes (a past date is ignored). Empty means no closure in effect; add an entry when a day needs to be taken offline.

closures._comment: INDEFINITE CLOSURE ACTIVE — closed for the Big Bites rebrand (message updated 2026-07-20). The "*" key closes online ordering until further notice: /api/order rejects, no slots are offered, and the order page shows the popup + banner with this message. TO REOPEN: delete the "*" entry (leave "closures": {}) and push to main.

*.title: We’re rebranding — back soon!
*.message: We’re closed for a little while — we’re rebranding and making big improvements to our store and menu! You’re going to love it. Just a little more patience — see you very soon!

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: Trading-day rollover hour (0–23, shop local time). 4 = the day's orders / takings / Z-report run 4am-to-4am, so late-night orders taken after midnight still count toward the day the shop opened. 0 = plain midnight-to-midnight. Harmless for shops that close before midnight (nothing to reclassify).

promo._comment: Food Station's printed offer is 'spend over £40, free garlic bread or drink' — a threshold reward the simple promo schema can't express. The generic online discount is DISABLED so we don't apply a discount the shop didn't ask for. TODO confirm desired promo.

payments._comment_cvcThreshold: Order total (in pence) above which a customer paying with a saved card has to re-enter their CVV. Defends against account-takeover for higher-value orders. Set to 0 to never require CVC re-collection. £50 = 5000.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the restaurant before ordering.
